'''Shirataki''' (Japanese: '''シラタキ''' ''Shirataki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM118|Aiming for the Top Floor!]]''. She is one of the ninjas in the [[Kantonian Gym]], and is in charge of its third floor.

Shirataki gave {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}} a target trial, where the aim was to hit a target with three {{wp|shuriken}}. Ash and {{an|Kiawe}} were successful, but {{an|Lana}} outshone them by hitting three different target boards with ease. The trio was subsequently able to advance to [[Charlie Charma]]'s floor. {{an|Lillie}}'s aim, on the other hand, was so poor that it endangered everyone else, and she was forced to remain on the third floor to perfect her throwing technique.
